title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
summary: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice.
body: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice.
summaryZh: Fyxer通过集成OpenAI模型、微调技术及长期记忆机制，构建了能够处理复杂行政任务的AI助理。该系统通过持续的用户反馈循环，实现了对邮件管理和沟通风格的个性化适配，展示了AI Agent在提升企业办公效率方面的实际应用价值。

aiReview.reasonZh: 展示了AI Agent在企业级行政助理场景的落地实践，对AI产品化具有参考意义。
